value.rationale: The question of fluctuation decay under deterministic periodic forcing of a canonical expanding interval family is natural. A complete positive-branch phase diagram identifies when individually simple polynomial relaxation modes coalesce into a dominant quadratic Jordan block, with an exact, physically interpretable squared-position lag covariance and two distinct sign-change delays. The fold threshold and exact observable behavior go beyond the generic linear-algebra fact that Jordan powers contain polynomial prefactors; no arbitrary computation cutoff or unsupported downstream theorem is used.
